decisions.reason: The articulated construction dumper builds directly on the firm's core vehicle engineering and service know-how, so the firm can read its market feedback and refine it with its own R&D.
The material lift line sits close to the established offer and shows strong rental demand and a large order, so the firm can readily absorb and exploit customer feedback.

The underground loader is distant from the core offer, but its documented 1,000 operating hours in seven months give interpretable field evidence the firm's engineering base can learn from and improve on, which justifies continuing it.
